entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to modify PDU session parameters.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDU session modification.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject PDU session modification request.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by network to request PDU session release.

entities.name: Timer T3581
entities.description: Timer used for PDU session modification procedure retransmissions.

entities.name: Procedure Transaction Identity
entities.description: Identifier allocated for PDU session modification procedure.

entities.name: PDU session ID IE
entities.description: Information element identifying the PDU session.

entities.name: Invalid PDU session identity condition
entities.description: Condition when network rejects with cause #43 invalid PDU session identity.

entities.name: RQI revocation condition
entities.description: Condition when UE has revoked reflective QoS usage but receives DL packet with RQI.

entities.name: Procedure collision condition
entities.description: Condition when UE-requested modification collides with network-requested release.

entities.name: Service area restriction condition
entities.description: Condition when 5GSM message not forwarded due to service area restrictions.

entities.name: Routing failure condition
entities.description: Condition when 5GSM message not forwarded due to routing failure.

entities.name: Satellite PLMN restriction condition
entities.description: Condition when satellite NG-RAN cell indicates PLMN not allowed at current location.

entities.name: N1 NAS signalling connection release condition
entities.description: Condition when N1 NAS signalling connection is released during procedure.

relations.description: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure involves sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.
Procedure starts timer T3581 for retransmission control.
T3581 expiry triggers retransmission of PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST.
On T3581 expiry, UE resets and restarts timer T3581 for retransmissions.
Invalid PDU session identity condition stops timer T3581.
Procedure collision condition causes UE to abort modification procedure.
RQI revocation condition establishes that UE ignores RQI in DL packets.
Service area restriction condition stops timer T3581.
Routing failure condition stops timer T3581.
Satellite PLMN restriction condition stops timer T3581.
N1 connection release condition stops timer T3581.
N1 connection release condition may trigger immediate retransmission of PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST.
